title: Microsoft Agent Framework at Build 2024
summary: Microsoft introduced the Microsoft Agent Framework at the Build conference, providing a new standard for building and orchestrating multi-agent systems. The framework simplifies the creation of autonomous agents that can collaborate, handle complex workflows, and leverage existing AI tools. Deep integration with Azure services ensures that these agents are scalable and ready for enterprise-level deployment. This release is a key part of Microsoft's strategy to empower developers in the era of agentic AI.
